A small gyrocopter with a rotor on top, two side-mounted engines, and skis as landing gear.
Prerequisite: None (must be made with expert engineering; 2,000 GP of resources)
Speed 4 mph; Crew 1; Passengers 0; Cargo 300 lb.; AC 19; HP 27

Characters traveling in these vehicles use the vehicle’s speed in miles per hour to determine their rate of travel, and they don’t choose a travel pace. These vehicles require Fuel, which weighs 10 pounds and costs 1 GP for each 8 hours of travel. (Characters can use the alchemy profession to craft Fuel.)
A three-wheeled motor vehicle with luxurious wood paneling.
Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with any goblin cartel
Speed 3 mph; Crew 1; Passengers 0; Cargo 600 lb.; AC 19; HP 27

Characters traveling in these vehicles use the vehicle’s speed in miles per hour to determine their rate of travel, and they don’t choose a travel pace. These vehicles require Fuel, which weighs 10 pounds and costs 1 GP for each 8 hours of travel. (Characters can use the alchemy profession to craft Fuel.)
